citation.authors: Hamer HM, Wall BT, Kiskini A, de Lange A, Groen BBL, Bakker JA, Gijsen AP, Verdijk LB, van Loon LJC
citation.title: Carbohydrate co-ingestion with protein does not further augment post-prandial muscle protein accretion in older men

population.description: 24 healthy older men (Maastricht), 12 per arm, randomised to PRO or PRO-CHO; screened by OGTT for type 2 diabetes (WHO criteria); excluded BMI >30, diabetes, regular exercise. Age 75±1 y and BMI 25.8±0.4 kg/m2 are mean±SEM of all 24 (Subjects); SD computed as SEM x sqrt(24). Group values are in each protocol's override.

protocols.name: pro_fasted
protocols.description: Fasting baseline of the PRO group (n=12), Table 1 'Basal' values and resting blood pressure; Table 1 does not say when they were drawn; it prints them beside the screening OGTT's 120-min values and the HOMA and OGIS that Pretesting says were computed from the OGTT's venous glucose and insulin (5.4 x 21 / 22.5 = 5.0, against HOMA 5.1), so most likely the OGTT's basal sample, though the test day also had a basal sample after an overnight fast; either is a basal morning sample, so a short fasted morning arm with water only stands for it; blood pressure has no described measurement; group age and BMI SD computed as SEM x sqrt(12) from Table 1 (age 1.2, BMI 0.4)

protocols.name: pro_cho_fasted
protocols.description: Fasting baseline of the PRO-CHO group (n=12), Table 1 'Basal' values and resting blood pressure; Table 1 does not say when they were drawn; it prints them beside the screening OGTT's 120-min values and the HOMA and OGIS that Pretesting says were computed from the OGTT's venous glucose and insulin (5.4 x 21 / 22.5 = 5.0, against HOMA 5.1), so most likely the OGTT's basal sample, though the test day also had a basal sample after an overnight fast; either is a basal morning sample, so a short fasted morning arm with water only stands for it; blood pressure has no described measurement; group age and BMI SD computed as SEM x sqrt(12) from Table 1 (age 1.0, BMI 0.7)

protocols.name: pro_drink
protocols.description: PRO group (n=12): at t=0 a 450 mL drink with 20 g intrinsically labelled micellar casein and no carbohydrate, after an overnight fast; arterialised samples at 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90 ... 360 min. Subjects arrived at 08:00 and drank after cannulation, the basal sample and a biopsy, at a clock time not printed; fat is not stated for either drink, nor carbohydrate other than the absence of the added 40 g (carbs 0 and fat 0 entered); the standardized evening meal of the day before (33 kJ/kg, 44/22/34 En%) has no printed time and is not entered. Group age and BMI SD = SEM x sqrt(12) from Table 1 (age 1.2, BMI 0.4)

protocols.name: pro_cho_drink
protocols.description: PRO-CHO group (n=12): at t=0 a 450 mL drink with 20 g intrinsically labelled micellar casein plus 40 g carbohydrate (50% dextrose monohydrate, 50% maltodextrin), after an overnight fast; arterialised samples at 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90 ... 360 min. Subjects arrived at 08:00 and drank after cannulation, the basal sample and a biopsy, at a clock time not printed; fat is not stated for either drink (fat 0 entered); the standardized evening meal of the day before (33 kJ/kg, 44/22/34 En%) has no printed time and is not entered. Group age and BMI SD = SEM x sqrt(12) from Table 1 (age 1.0, BMI 0.7)

meals.food: vanilla-flavoured micellar casein drink with dextrose and maltodextrin
